context.description: A string indicating the root of your files.

lintOnStart.description: Whether the first compilation lints every file it covers. `false` leaves a watch run reporting only the modules webpack rebuilds; a build has nothing but a first compilation, so it always lints.

checks.description: The checks to run, each with the options only it understands.

use.description: The check to run, either the name of a built-in one or a check adapter.
